_about: Hand-checked links from Wikidata 'dedicated to' (P825) targets to Source Map deity ids. 'map' replaces the automatic name match for that target; 'exclude' blocks a target whose name collides with an unrelated app figure. Every entry here was checked against the app record and the Wikidata item on 2026-10-15.
